title.zh: SkyAI Plans Up to $201 Million Tender at $3 for 95% of Shares and Warrants, Reje
title.en: SkyAI Plans Up to $201 Million Tender at $3 for 95% of Shares and Warrants, Reje

current_state.zh: Solana treasury company SkyAI (Nasdaq: SKYA) plans a ~$201M cash tender offer at $3 per share and per pre-funded warrant for up to 95% of its stock and warrants starting around Oct. 15, funded by cash and SOL sales, and rejected Forward Industries' unsolicited all-stock exchange proposal as undervaluing the company.
